findings.text: correctness lens, medium: In resume + --from-stage mode, `pipeline.skip_to_stage` is emitted even though the dispatch loop will now correctly skip earlier stages via `skip_until_stage`; RQFROM-2 says the event must not be followed by running an earlier stage, which the loop now satisfies, but the event's presence in a resume context (not a pure --from-stage run) has no requirement backing it and can confuse consumers that key on this event to decide whether earlier stages ran.
